annotations.title: List the layers you can export

description: Use when the user wants to know which data layers export_data can export. Returns each layer with its filters, row cap and whether a bbox is required. The layers are tenements, minedex, drillholes, wamex, activity (historical exploration), prospectivity (score grid), sites (training deposits), faults, worms_mag and worms_grav. The database holds many more tables (full text of the WAMEX reports, the raw MDHDB assay mirror; 5,000+ tables in all): sql_tables lists them and sql_query reads them.
name: list_export_layers
title: List the layers you can export
